title: ALL ARTS TV (ALL ARTS) - Videos
description:
All for arts and arts for all. Powered by public media. 

ALL ARTS’ Webby-winning programming – from digital shorts and feature films to news and written interviews – is available through AllArts.org, the free ALL ARTS app on all major streaming platforms and @AllArtsTV on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and Tiktok. 

Created by The WNET Group, the community-supported home of New York’s PBS stations. For all the ways to watch, visit AllArts.org/Everywhere. To support ALL ARTS, make a donation: https://ow.ly/OUZN50Us7aH
